reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our latest update, water depth is now more responsive to changes in the environment, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience. Read more about the changes and how they enhance your city-building experience here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Revamped in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've revamped the water mechanics in Provincia! The water depth now updates in real-time with terrain changes, making for a more immersive and dynamic city-building experience. Explore the full details of these improvements in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
